interpretation: The long tail of measured service listings is thin in the publisher's measured slice. Generic per-transaction monetization is unlikely to be attractive for an average tail listing. This does not estimate attainable AgentMine volume, supplier earnings or willingness to pay.
caveats: Publisher data, not independently audited transactions or verified distinct buyers.
Rolling 30-day window and coverage are incomplete; this is not total x402 ecosystem flow.
Top-10 share is reported to one decimal; sensitivity assumes rounding to nearest 0.1 percentage point.
Average includes measured service listings that may have zero flow; not a median and not representative of active paying providers.
Some services share payout addresses; address-based attribution may not identify unique legal suppliers.
Wallets and settlement events do not establish organic end-customer purchases, AgentMine customers or payment willingness.
